name: Shipping and Handling
summary: Wharfmaster Steamfizzle points you toward Tazzik with Friz’s Secret Stash. The shipment raises questions about its passage through customs.

sections.title: At the Dock
sections.body: Tazzik is waiting on the dock in Steamwheedle Port for the crate you carry. Wharfmaster Steamfizzle directs you to him, though he claims to know nothing about the delivery. He urges haste and warns you against drawing the wrong attention. The shipment comes from Powderfuse Port, and its passage through customs is in question.

faq.q: Who is asking me to deliver the crate?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Steamfizzle directs you to Tazzik with Friz’s Secret Stash.

faq.q: Who am I delivering Friz’s Secret Stash to?
faq.answer: You are to deliver Friz’s Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.
It is a shipment Friz sent for Tazzik. The completion text praises its quality.

faq.q: Where did the shipment come from?
faq.answer: Tazzik says he can smell Powderfuse Port on you.

faq.q: Why does Steamfizzle tell me to hurry?
faq.answer: Steamfizzle warns you not to draw the wrong attention.

faq.q: Was the shipment cleared by customs?
faq.answer: Tazzik says the shipment has been cleared by customs, but suggests Friz’s money may be a problem.
